name: [😂Meme Pt. 2] Steal An Umamusume 🐎
desc:
Welcome to Steal An Umamusume!
Make sure to Like and Follow the game for future content!

What's new in the update?
= New Fanmade and Original Characters 🎤
= Fusion coming soon...


How to Play:
💸When you get in use your starting cash to buy a Umamusume Character
🥷 Steal Umamusume from the other players around the map to boost progress
💸 Generate money using your Umamusume
🐦‍🔥 Use that money to upgrade stables and rebirth
✋ Defend your hard earned Characters with tools

💻 Supports Desktop, Mobile and Tablet players
